test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cardiologists are doctors.

Some cardiologists are neurologists.

**Conclusions:**

I) Some doctors are cardiologists.

II) Some doctors are neurologists.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
According to the question

**All cardiologists are doctors.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87b87efbb92670d74ba762b4112d63c8766c59bff71930d9e5657ae62c573b15.png] 

**Some cardiologists are neurologists.**
